@@U02515@@
Stand by me, for I will need you often when the routine of your daily world distresses me.

@@U02517@@
(Enters in haste.)

@@U02518@@
Serene Highness, I never thought that one day I would bring to you news of such great good fortune! I am blessed in your presence, Majesty, with supreme happiness! Our accounts are settled, every bill paid, we have escaped the usurer’s clutches, and I am relieved of the torments of Hell! Heaven could not be more joyous!

@@U02520@@
(Following in haste.)

@@U02521@@
Sire, we've begun to pay off the mercenaries, and the whole army’s reenlisted! The troops are in fine fettle, and tapster and tart are about their trades!

@@U02523@@
How freely you're all breathing for a change! Your faces have lost their folds and are smiling again! And to think you ran to tell me!

@@U02525@@
(Who has already entered.)

@@U02526@@
These are the men you should ask, Sire. It was they who did it.

@@U02528@@
By right, I think the Chancellor should explain it.

@@U02530@@
(Approaching slowly.)

@@U02531@@
Yes, whose old age is finally blest. Hear now and behold this fateful paper that has turned all woe to weal.

@@U02532@@
(He reads.)
translation:
@@U02515@@
请支持我，因为当你的日常生活让我感到痛苦时，我会经常需要你。

@@U02517@@
（匆匆进来。）

@@U02518@@
殿下，没想到有一天我会给您带来这么大的福报！陛下，我因您的存在而感到无比的幸福！我们的账都结清了，账单都付清了，我们脱离了高利贷者的魔掌，我也摆脱了地狱的折磨！天堂不能更欢乐了！

@@U02520@@
（连忙跟上。）

@@U02521@@
陛下，我们已经开始给雇佣兵还钱了，全军重新入伍了！部队状态良好，酒馆和馅饼正在忙着他们的生意！

@@U02523@@
你们多么自由地呼吸着改变！你们脸上的皱纹消失了，又露出笑容了！没想到你跑来告诉我了！

@@U02525@@
（谁已经进来了。）

@@U02526@@
这些是您应该询问的人，陛下。是他们干的。

@@U02528@@
按理说，我认为总理应该解释一下。

@@U02530@@
（慢慢靠近。）

@@U02531@@
是的，他的晚年终于得到了祝福。现在请听听并看看这篇命运攸关的报纸，它将所有的灾难变成了幸福。

@@U02532@@
（他读着。）
